entities.summary: František Mrázek was a controversial Czech entrepreneur, often referred to as the "Godfather of Czech Organized Crime". Mrázek covertly influenced Czech politics for almost twenty years. In 2006 he was assassinated by a sniper. Most of the publicly available information about his criminal activities and contacts with the politicians leaked from police archives after his death. These sources suspect he was involved in over 30 murders.

entities.summary: František Mrázek was a controversial Czech entrepreneur, often referred to as the "Godfather of Czech Organized Crime". Mrázek covertly influenced Czech politics for almost twenty years. In 2006 he was assassinated by a sniper. Most of the publicly available information about his criminal activities and contacts with the politicians leaked from police archives after his death. These sources suspect he was involved in over 30 murders.
